title: Browser window
description: A real screenshot inside a browser frame: rises in with a slight tilt, scrolls, then zooms to a highlighted region with an accent box and a callout.

title.description: Heading above the main element. Trusted HTML: use word for the accent word.

screenshot.description: Path to a real screenshot in the scene folder (e.g. assets/page.png). Empty shows a placeholder that must not ship.

screenshotWidth.description: Pixel width of the screenshot file (maps highlight coordinates).

scroll.description: Pixels (in screenshot coordinates) to scroll before the zoom; 0 for none.

highlight.description: {x, y, w, h} region in screenshot pixels to zoom to and mark; null for none.

callout.description: Short label shown under the window after the zoom. Empty to hide.

lang.description: Language of the copy (BCP 47, e.g. en, tr, de). Sets <html lang>, which drives uppercase rules (tr: i -> İ).

duration.description: Scene length in seconds. new-scene.sh --params also rewrites data-duration to match.

checks: the screenshot is real and current
textcheck: callout above the bottom UI zone
